optimal_policy.interpretation: Boltzmann distribution with energy -R and temperature beta_KL

free_energy_identity.equation: J = E[R] + beta_KL * H(pi) + beta_KL * E[ln pi_ref] = -F + const

P1.title: Optimal temperature scaling
P1.test: Train on tasks of varying entropy; plot reward vs beta_KL per task class
P1.falsification: Optimal beta_KL independent of task entropy

P2.title: Grokking latent period
P2.test: Modular arithmetic datasets varying modulus p; measure H before/after grokking
P2.falsification: r < 0.3 between predicted and observed stall periods

P3.title: Alignment-capability bound
P3.test: Train family varying beta_KL; plot A*C. Should show universal maximum.
P3.falsification: Monotone increase of A*C beyond predicted bound on high-beta side

design_principles.task_matched_temperature: Set beta_KL from H_task, not grid search
design_principles.annealed_alignment: High T early (capability), low T late (alignment crystallisation)
